messages:
emma: Heads-up — onboarding Mercator LoRA adapter (cust-mercator). Quick smoke shows tensor-map mismatch when running their int4 artifact, attaching minimal logs.
raj: Can you paste the failing eval snippet? quickpacks are easiest to repro.
emma: Sure — ran their quickpack against our 4bit runtime, failure on step 3 (KV cache shape). Log excerpt:
```
ERROR: kv_cache.cpp:87 mismatch dims: expected (batch=1, heads=32, seq=1024) got (batch=1, heads=32, seq=960)
Model: mercator_lora_v1_int4
Adapter merge: mercator-lora-2026-02
Cmd: ./rundir/eval --model mercator_lora_v1_int4 --pack mercator_quickpack.json --quant int4
```

marta: That seq=960 looks like a tokenizer/sequence-length mismatch. Did we truncate differently during merge?
raj: Could be. Mercator uses a custom token remap for emojis and emojis-only spans. If tokenizer emits different EOS markers, KV lengths shift. Any token diffs in the pack?
emma: I diffed their tokenized prompts vs base model — saw extra BOS tokens in some examples and a trailing 64-token chunk merged without EOS. Small but it shifts cached offsets.
taylor: I can run a tokenizer alignment check. Which commit/tag of the base model did they merge onto?
emma: base tag: rwd-base-v3-2026-01-15. Adapter applied on top as mercator/loRA@2026-02-10.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging job #4207 started (runtime: int4-optim, region: us-west). Logs streaming.
raj: For immediate triage — try re-merging with our tokenizer mapping shim: set TOKENIZER_PATCH=remap_v1 and re-run quickpack.
emma: Ran that locally — improved but still 2 failures: a numeric drift on generation score and one token-length mismatch.
marta: Numeric drift could be quantization-sensitive. Did you compare float32 outputs vs int4? small scalars drift expected, but >1.5% on coherence metric is concerning.
emma: Float32 vs int4 diff on Rouge-L: 0.03 vs 0.295 (so 0.265 delta) on one prompt. That's >1.5% relative.
raj: Oof. Could be adapter fused with a kernel that gets poorly quantized. Try remapping adapter to per-channel scale before quantization: --adapter-scale-mode=per_channel.
taylor: Also confirm that the merged state dict didn't reorder parameters. Our merge tool writes param keys sorted, but third-party exporters sometimes shuffle. Can you paste a small key list?
emma: Key sample:
```
conv1.weight
attn.q_proj.weight
attn.k_proj.weight
attn.v_proj.weight
attn.o_proj.weight
ffn.w1.weight
```
Order looks normal.
marta: Could we reproduce on a different runtime (int8 or float16) to isolate whether it's quantization-only?
emma: float16 run produced acceptable scores (diff <0.01). So quantization-specific.
raj: Then plan: 1) taylor runs tokenizer alignment + TOKENIZER_PATCH repro; 2) marta tries per_channel adapter scaling and re-quantizes; 3) I will run a parameter-order invariant merge script to ensure no accidental rekeying. If all pass, produce new quickpack.
taylor: Starting tokenizer check now. Will ping when done. :eyes:
marta: I'll kick off quant pipeline with --adapter-scale-mode=per_channel and attach logs to this thread.
emma: Thanks. I'll compile a minimal repro with the single failing prompt and share. If we need, we can ask Mercator for the original training merge script.
raj: Also add a short eval of prefix-caching: run with --prefix_cache 1 and --max_seq 1024 to make sure cache alignment is stable.
emma: Noted. I'll run with those flags after marta posts quant logs.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging job #4207 completed. exit=0. artifacts: s3://ci/staging/4207/mercator-smoke.tar.gz
taylor: Tokenizer alignment repro: their tokenizer emits a hidden U+FEFF at start of some examples; stripping that resolves the seq=960 case. Patching pack now.
marta: Quant pipeline results (short): per_channel reduces Rouge-L drift from 0.265 -> 0.02 on the failing prompt. attaching trimmed results to artifacts.
emma: Great. So root causes: stray invisible char in customer prompts + adapter per-channel scaling needed for int4 quant. I'll prepare a short remediation note for SEs and add a small sanitizer to quickpacks.
raj: Perfect. Once you update the quickpack, let's run the full smoke suite and ship the updated adapter artifact. thx everyone.
emma: Will do. Closing loop when full smoke passes.
